components.name: ProgressBar
components.description:
Figma Progress-Bar (1536:260): 8px Neutral/Subtle track, rounded, Active fill; Body/Base/Regular text, gap XSmall.
Layout=Inline puts the label after the bar; Layout=Stacked (15304:45…) puts a Header row (Label Body/Base/Bold fills,
Value Body/Base/Regular hugs, baseline-aligned) above the full-width track.

props.name: layout
props.description: Figma Layout: `inline` (default: the label trails the bar) · `stacked` (a Label · Value row above a full-width bar).

props.name: label
props.description:
The label (Figma Text, shown with Label=Yes). Inline: trails the bar, and `true` shows the rounded percentage.
 Stacked: leads the row above the bar and names it; `true` leaves only the value.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Stacked only: the text at the end of the row (Figma Value), such as "3 of 5 steps". Default: the rounded percentage.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

props.name: scale
props.description: Status theme only: `quota` for usage against a limit (high = bad); default `completion`.

components.name: ProgressCircle
components.description:
Figma Progress-Circle (1531:13954) + Progress-Circle/Icon (6915:62964): 20px ring (2px Support/Subtle border, no
fill) with a 12px Support/Solid pie from 12 o'clock; Done = full solid disc (it covers the ring) + 12px
icon-check-solid.

props.name: value
props.description: 0–100. 100 renders the Done state with a check.

props.name: decorative
props.description:
The ring only repeats what a visible word beside it already says (a status heading, a task's step): it is hidden
from screen readers instead of being a second progressbar. Its own `label` text still shows.
